method: Ghidra decompilation and instruction listings of the identified executable. Name literals, the vftable slots named below and the 0x03A20000 immediate were compared with the PE bytes through its section table. Addresses are virtual addresses. Call order and call-site argument counts were measured from the Lua 5.1 bytecode of the shipped client scripts.
scope: Static Lua call contracts for the natives reached first by WorldMaster._onInit and DesktopWidget._onInit, in measured call order: declared argument and return StackOperator lists, owning native class, callback, forwarding target and yield behavior. Natives already recorded in manifests/widget_native_call_contract.json are referenced, not repeated. Argument indices count internal ExecuteParameters cells. A receiverless Global call supplies the global object at native-frame position 1, as manifests/global_native_call_contract.json receiverlessConvention records. Client-side contracts do not establish server behavior.

framework.reference: manifests/widget_native_call_contract.json framework: registration, the 0x00CC9D60 type registry, argument marshalling through 0x00D19A20 and the return pushers.
framework.listOrder: Each registrar builds the return list first and the argument list second, then passes the argument list and the return list as the fourth and fifth arguments of the per-class wrapper.

typedCastReaders.0x0071BC90: Reads a tag 4 value and casts the LuaControl through 0x009DA6CC to CharaBase (type descriptor 0x012709A4).
typedCastReaders.0x0071C190: Reads a tag 4 value and casts the LuaControl through 0x009DA6CC to WidgetBase (type descriptor 0x012C1964).

framework.virtualCallbacks: A callback that is a three-instruction thunk loads the receiver vftable and jumps through a fixed slot. The target then depends on the receiver's native class.
framework.inlBinding: Each row's _u script declares a descriptor named <luaName>_inl that returns two strings, a receiver selector and <luaName>_cpp. The step that maps the _cpp name onto the registered functor was not traced. The only _cpp literal is at 0x00FDF2CC, referenced from 0x007634B0.

callOrder.method: Static walk of the shipped script bytecode. Call sites are taken in instruction order. Each Lua-defined method is expanded at its first call through the class method tables of the shipped scripts, every branch is included, and a leading unconditional jump over compiled-out code is skipped. Receivers loaded from the desktopWidget and worldMaster globals resolve through DesktopWidget and WorldMaster, and every other receiver resolves through the walking class. The method tables include definitions whose key is loaded into a register before the table store, which covers the DesktopWidget methods defined in widget/desktopwidget_connector. Only names that the xivl-client-scripts N-API index lists are kept, each at its first occurrence.
callOrder.DesktopWidget._onInitParent: The DesktopWidget order expands its superclass _onInit call as WidgetBaseClass._onInit. The scripts do not declare that parent, so this expansion is an inference.

notFunctors._string: Value namespace, not a functor native.
notFunctors._table: Value namespace, not a functor native.
notFunctors._isAlive: IndividualRef metatable field, not a functor native.

callOrder.superCallArguments: WorldMaster._onInit passes one argument to _callSuperClassFunc. DesktopWidget._onInit passes the method name followed by all results of a Lua method that returns five values, a six-argument call. The ActorBaseClass _u descriptor maps _callSuperClassFunc to _callSuperClassFunction_cpp.

arguments.note: Text data number. The callback adds 0x03A20000 before the request.

rows.behavior: Takes the object reached through 0x00CC7510, gets a sheet object from 0x0075F5A0 and calls 0x00767230 on the object at +0x108 with that sheet object, the name and argument 0 plus 0x03A20000. Virtual slot 1 of the sheet object is then called with the name. A nonzero result passes the name to 0x00447450 and returns at once. A zero result yields through 0x00CD2860 with a TextDataReadResumeChecker built by 0x00712C80.

resumeChecker.poll: 0x00718640 calls slot 1 of the stored sheet object with the name. A nonzero result passes the name to 0x00447450 and resumes.

arguments.note: The alternatives list is built by 0x0072B4B0 and appended through 0x00CCA2D0 in 0x0072C410.

rows.behavior: 0x0078CC30 resolves the identity through 0x00CC7A50 and pushes a found control at once. When none resolves and 0x00CC7180 returns false, it calls 0x00CC7160 and 0x00CC78C0 and pushes that control when 0x00CC72A0 reports its +0x7D flag set. Otherwise it yields through 0x00CD2860 with a 0x10-byte CreateStaticActorResumeChecker built by 0x0078D800.

resumeChecker.poll: 0x0078D880 resolves the stored identity through 0x00CC7A50 and resumes when 0x00CC72A0 reports the +0x7D flag set.

It builds a SendStoryboardCommandPickUp value from arguments 3 and 4: WithInt through 0x00717050, WithTwoInts through 0x00717120, WithString through 0x007171B0 and WithNone through 0x007175F0. 0x006EBE80 then passes the control identity from ExecuteParameters +0x0C, arguments 1 and 2 and the pickup to 0x0075BAD0, or adds argument 0 and calls 0x0075BB00.
Stores the count at DesktopWidget +0x68 and passes it to 0x0075EE70, which creates that many 0x24-byte cursor objects through 0x00564B50 and inserts each through 0x00565D30.

Passes argument 0 minus 1 and argument 1 to 0x0075EFC0. For cursor 1, when DesktopWidget +0x7C is clear, it also updates the identity cached at +0x70 through 0x0075EB30, depending on the 0x00CC7BE0 test.
Stores the distance at DesktopWidget +0x74 and passes argument 0 minus 1 and the distance to 0x0075F010, which bounds-checks the cursor index and forwards to 0x0055EB30.

Reads the identity for argument 0 minus 1 through 0x0075F0E0. Identity -0x40000000 pushes Nil. Otherwise the identity is resolved through 0x00CC9320 and 0x00CC7A50. A missing control or a control whose +0x5C byte is zero pushes Nil, and any other control is pushed as LuaControl*.
Pushes the result of 0x0075B690 plus 1, a one-based cursor number.

The callback jumps through receiver vftable slot +0x138. PlayerBase slot 0x006DEAA0 returns without pushing. MyPlayer slot 0x007051F0 reads the identity from 0x0075C690. Identity -0x40000000, an unresolved identity or a CharaBase whose +0x5C byte is zero pushes Nil. Any other control is pushed as LuaControl*.

boundaries: Deferred rows carry registration and declared lists only. Their handlers and forwarding targets were not recorded.
_loadTextDataPermanently is registered on ActorBase. WorldMaster._onInit calls it on its own receiver, and the binding that resolves it for WorldMaster was not traced.

DesktopWidget._onInit calls _callSuperClassFunc with six post-receiver arguments. The declared _callSuperClassFunction list holds Utf8String and Variable. manifests/widget_native_call_contract.json framework.variableArgumentReader establishes conditional recognized suffix consumption, so list length alone does not imply a GetArguments_ error. Source-level binding and runtime success remain unresolved.
_getStaticActor belongs to Global and is called without a receiver. Its position is an ExecuteParameters position.
The DesktopWidget call order treats WidgetBaseClass as the superclass reached by _callSuperClassFunc. That parent is inferred from the script that tests DesktopWidget inside WidgetBaseClass._onInit.
Call order is static call-site order across every branch. It does not establish which calls run at runtime.
These are client marshalling contracts. They do not establish text data content, widget layout, or server behavior.
